name: BACH_0222
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (98%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set holds only Benign; second model and all 5 similar cases agree.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 98%, InSitu 1%, Invasive <1% | Strongly favors Benign |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 88th percentile | Unflagged; OOD fairly high |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 Benign | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 4, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; associated with lower invasive likelihood [F2] · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score; stroma infiltration scarce [F3] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Low score; third-largest concept term; spot check 0/20 [F4] · Unreliable
- **Variation in nuclear size** (regions 0, 10, 11) · context · Only 5% of reference cases vary less; uniform nuclei [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion: top 3 regions drop invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007): not shown to reflect classifier use. Leans on Unreliable mitotic figures (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Probabilities are miscalibrated: ECE 5% (CI 3–18%) on a small test set.
- Image is atypical: 88th OOD percentile; reliability score ranks simulated errors modestly (AUROC 0.69).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 5, 6** — confirm glandular architecture is benign, not neoplastic.
2. **Region 11** — look for infiltrating stroma; its concept score is highest here.
3. **Region 7** — check mitoses and necrosis directly; concept scores are unreliable.
